limitations: All quantities are nonnegative Solidity integers and each division floors at its written position.
Fixtures do not replace a same-block price, position, accumulator, role, pause, cap, or allowlist read.

records.units: 1e18 fixed-point when collateral, BTC/USD price, and MUSD debt use their deployed 18-decimal units

records.expression: belowWarning = currentCR < warningCR; belowMinimum = currentCR < minimumCR
records.boundary: Equality is not below the threshold.

records.expression: require payment >= totalFees; principalPayment = payment - totalFees; require principalPayment <= principal; remainingPrincipal = principal - principalPayment

records.rounding: The combined accumulator is calculated independently and the clamp prevents underflow after settlement.

records.scope: institutional principal only at a consistent state coordinate

records.expression: classicDebt and institutionalOutstandingDebt remain separately named; no combined product ratio exists without a separately accepted definition
